industry: Pharma cold chain logistics -- biological samples, vaccines, medicines (GDP-compliant)
size: Logistics centers in Spain, UK, USA, and Germany; reaches Europe, North America, and South-east Asia

facts.claim: Cool Chain Logistics has operated since 2011, describing itself as a young but well-established company in the pharma cold-chain sector, headquartered in Getafe (Madrid) with additional presence in Barcelona.
facts.source_snippet: Cool Chain Logistics es una empresa joven y dinamica pero muy consolidada en el sector [with experience] desde 2011... Main office: C/ Leonardo Da Vinci 2 2B, 28906 Getafe (Madrid). Additional Spanish presence in Barcelona.

facts.claim: The company operates logistics centers in Spain (Madrid-Barcelona), the UK (York), the USA (Indianapolis), and Germany (Darmstadt), with solutions reaching Europe, North America, and South-east Asia.
facts.source_snippet: The organization maintains logistic centers across Spain (Madrid-Barcelona), UK (York), USA (Indianapolis), and Germany (Darmstadt)... Cool Chain's solutions also stretch across Europe, North America, and South-east Asia.

facts.claim: Cool Chain Logistics specializes in transporting biological samples, vaccines, and medicines across temperature ranges from ultra-low frozen (-80C/-20C) to refrigerated (2C/8C) to ambient (15C/25C), holding GDP, ISO, and ISTA temperature-qualification certifications.
facts.source_snippet: Transporte de muestras biologicas, vacunas y medicamentos [under] spanning from ultra-low frozen temperatures (-80C/-20C) to refrigerated conditions (2C/8C) and ambient temperature settings (15C/25C)... Holding a Good Distribution Practices (GDP) certificate for medicine distribution... complies with ISO regulations and ISTA temperature qualification certifications.

facts.claim: The company uses a reusable high-performance equipment system claiming '100% monitoring of interior temperature' for all shipments, with autonomous temperature maintenance for a minimum of 120 hours -- part of a reuse model that reports 375 tonnes of CO2 reduction and 10,166 fewer boxes destroyed compared to single-use packaging.
facts.source_snippet: un sistema de reutilizacion de equipos de alto rendimiento [with] monitorizacion del 100% de la temperatura interior [and the ability to] mantener la temperatura de manera autonoma un minimo de 120 horas... REDUCCION DE 375 Tn CO2... REDUCCION DE 10166 CAJAS DESTRUIDAS.
